name: documentation

# Documentation

Apply the Documentation Style rule: minimal, scannable, only what a reader needs.

## Principles

- Lead with the essential; cut anything a reader can infer.
- Prefer terse bullets and small tables over paragraphs.
- Link instead of duplicating; keep one source of truth.
- No filler, restated context, or "as an AI" boilerplate.
- A short doc that gets read beats a complete one that does not.

## README

- One-line purpose, then Quick Start (copy-paste commands), then only the sections
  a newcomer needs. Link deeper docs; do not inline them.

## CHANGELOG

- Keep a Changelog format; one line per entry under `[Unreleased]`.
- Group as Added / Changed / Fixed / Removed. State what changed, not how.

## Before finishing

- Re-read as a stranger: is anything skippable? Cut it.
- Verify every command and example runs.
